# Check if "spiral galaxy" has the least apparent magnitude among all object types
# First, filter to only spiral galaxies
spiral_df = df[df['object type'] == 'spiral galaxy']

# Get the minimum apparent magnitude for spiral galaxies
min_mag_spiral = spiral_df['apparent magnitude'].min()

# Get the minimum apparent magnitude for all other object types
min_mag_others = df[df['object type'] != 'spiral galaxy']['apparent magnitude'].min()

# Check if spiral galaxy has the smallest minimum apparent magnitude
answer = (min_mag_spiral < min_mag_others)
